patterns: APPSC's favourite: SPSC members appointed by Governor, removed only by the President (Group-1, 2019).
APPSC asks 'not a UPSC function' = manner of reservation (G1 2022), APPSC established 1956 (2023), UPSC/Joint Commission appointed by President.
Other PSCs ask Article numbers (315, 317, 322), Art. 315(4) Governor request + President approval, JSPSC by Parliament on States' request, annual report to Governor.
Traps: removal of SPSC member by President after SC inquiry (not Governor/impeachment); UPSC is constitutional, not statutory.
App matches this well; some app items drift to Finance Commission and Lokpal panel, which belong to other topics.
